page.content:
1966–69 NBC series with Kirk, Spock, and Uhura.

How Star Trek: The Original Series connects

  • Artist: Gene Roddenberry — Roddenberry created The Original Series.
  • Topic: Star Trek — The Original Series is the first Star Trek weekly series.
  • Character: James T. Kirk — TOS is Kirk's command of the Enterprise.
  • Character: Spock — TOS is the series that makes Spock a cultural fixture.
  • Character: Nyota Uhura — Uhura is the TOS communications officer.
  • Series: Star Trek: The Next Generation — The Next Generation follows a century after TOS.

What is Star Trek: The Original Series?

The Original Series follows the Enterprise under Kirk as Starfleet's Cold War-era optimism — Spock, McCoy, Uhura, and the rest — meets new worlds each week.

Key threads lead to Gene Roddenberry, Star Trek, James T. Kirk, Spock, Nyota Uhura and Star Trek: The Next Generation.
